## What's Changed
* chore(mcp-server): prepare the npm package by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/31
* feat(mcp-server): serve tool sets chosen with MCPFABRIC_TOOLSETS by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/38
* chore(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 6.0.1 to 6.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/33
* chore(deps): bump gradle-wrapper from 9.8.1 to 9.8.2 in the gradle-plugins group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/34
* chore(deps): bump gradle/actions/setup-gradle from 6.4.0 to 6.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/36
* chore(deps): bump the npm-dependencies group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/37
* chore(deps): bump fast-uri from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 in /mcp-server by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/35
* feat(mcp-server): mark text written by players as untrusted data by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/39
* chore(deps): bump @hono/node-server, body-parser, ip-address and qs in /mcp-server by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/49
* feat: connect the MCP server without copying the token by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/51
* feat(mcp-server): build a Claude Desktop extension and prepare the MCP Registry listing by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/46
* feat: let the player pause the AI and let the AI message only the player by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/50
* feat(mcp-server): show a live agent dashboard as an MCP App by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/48
* feat(mcp-server): describe surroundings relative to the player's view by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/52
* feat(mcp-server): add mcpfabric-bench, scored tasks for agents by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/53
* feat(mcp-server): run scripts in a sandbox and keep skills by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/47
* feat(mcp-server): optional Claude Code channel for chat and game alerts by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/45
* feat: walker swims, climbs, opens doors, digs and pillars up by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/54
* feat: record calls with a lasting effect in an audit log by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/55
* feat: add a read-only bridge token by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/56
* feat: let the player approve risky calls in the game by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/57
* feat: label mobs and players on screenshots by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/58
* fix(mcp-server): inline the dashboard client only from plain export names by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/59
* fix: report navigation reached only once the player has landed by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/60
* chore(release): prepare 0.9.0 by @denfry in https://github.com/denfry/mcpfabric/pull/61
